images.scene: Early morning on a quiet Brazilian street, camera very low at sidewalk level. A single man in simple clothes, seen from BEHIND, small in the lower part of the frame, sweeps the sidewalk in front of a plain house with a straw broom, bent slightly, unhurried. The swept stretch of sidewalk in the foreground is clean; the street beyond dissolves into haze. Nothing else in the frame. Soft low light.

A plain plastered wall of a simple Brazilian house at dawn, camera low at sidewalk level. One old straw broom leans against the wall beside a closed door, and the stretch of sidewalk in front is freshly swept and clean. No people. Nothing else in the frame; wall and street dissolve into haze above. Soft low light, long shadow of the broom.
